intent: A calm, monochrome AI chat thread: the conversation staggers in, document-style replies stream in chunks that settle like ink, code is highlighted in greys, and one accent marks the send button and the live dot.

stack.fonts: font-display (Geist, tight tracking) for the title, font-sans (Geist) for messages, font-mono (Geist Mono) for metadata and code

layout.frame: @container root that fills its parent's height (the demo: 820px, 100dvh on phones, max-w 1040px on black). Window #0e0e10; from a 576px container: radius 22px, 1px #232327 border, inset highlight, deep shadow; full-bleed below it
layout.header: 64px; title + mono subtitle left, 44px New thread icon button right; 1px bottom rule
layout.column: max-w 720px centred, 16/32px gutters, 36px between messages, scrolls inside the window and follows the stream while pinned to the bottom
layout.userMessage: right-aligned #1c1c1f bubble with inset highlight, ink text, max-w min(82%, 30rem), radius 18px with 6px bottom-right corner, mono time under it
layout.assistantMessage: no bubble; 28px ink avatar with the initial (an accent dot only while writing) + name + time byline; content indented 38px from 576px; paragraphs, grey dash-marker lists, code block, source cards, Copy action
layout.codeBlock: #08080a panel with 1px line border, radius 14px, 44px caption with an ink language tag, faint filename and Copy/Copied button; 13px mono at 1.75; scrolls horizontally inside itself
layout.composer: #141416 card radius 20px with 1px line border (ink 30% on focus-within); attachment chips, auto-growing textarea (52–208px), toolbar with attach, mono model label, key hint (from 768px) and the round accent send button; mono disclaimer under it
layout.emptyState: New thread clears to a centred stack: mono 'NEW THREAD', 'What are we working on?' (display, clamp 1.5–2rem), one muted line

color.palette: PALETTE.dark / PALETTE.light written to --ct-* CSS variables; theme prop picks one
color.dark: window #0e0e10, raised #141416, bubble #1c1c1f, code #08080a, line #232327, rule #1b1b1e, ink #f4f4f5, body #cfcfd4, muted #a1a1aa, faint #8a8a93
color.light: window #ffffff, raised #fafafa, bubble #f1f1f3, code #f7f7f8, line #e4e4e7, rule #efeff1, ink #18181b, body #3f3f46, muted #52525b, faint #71717a
color.syntax: luminance only. Dark: base #bdbdc4, keyword #f4f4f5 weight 500, type #e4e4e7, number #d4d4d8, string #9d9da6, comment #75757e italic. Light: #52525b, #18181b, #27272a, #3f3f46, #71717a, #8a8a93
color.accent: one prop, default #ff9a6b: the send button fill (contrast-picked arrow) when there is something to send, and the dot on the assistant's avatar while it writes. List dashes, carets, focus rings, copied checks and the model label are greyscale.

motion.tokens: EASE_OUT [0.22,1,0.36,1], SPRING_UI 500/40, SPRING_SEND 420/34; one MOTION object holds every timing
motion.entrance: once 20% in view: the window rises 16px out of an 8px blur (500ms); header title, subtitle and New-thread button at 50ms steps; each message in reading order from a 12px rise and 8px blur, 60ms apart from 160ms; then the composer, its four controls 40ms apart, and the disclaimer
motion.thinking: the last reply waits for its block to land, then three grey dots pulse for 420ms
motion.streaming: uneven chunks of 2–6 characters (12% chance of a 10–22 burst) every 18–52ms, occasional 160–340ms pause; one timer at a time, cleared on unmount and Stop
motion.ink: each chunk is its own span keyed by its character offset and settles from opacity 0 and a 3px blur over 380ms (namespaced CSS keyframe ct-ink), across paragraphs, lists, inline code and highlighted code alike
motion.caret: 2px × 1.05em ink bar breathing 0.85→0.2 over 1.1s at the live end
motion.sources: after the stream: the label, then each card rising out of a blur 50ms apart, then Copy
motion.send: a sent bubble springs up out of the composer (16px, scale 0.96 from bottom-right, 6px blur, SPRING_SEND); the reply's byline enters and streams; send and stop swap with a pop on spring.ui and press to 0.92; the arrow lifts 2px once the draft has text
motion.stop: stopping freezes the text and labels the byline 'stopped'
motion.reducedMotion: every message renders complete; entrances are 150ms fades; no ink, caret or dots
motion.press: icon buttons 0.9, copy controls 0.95, source cards 0.98

responsive.narrow: full-bleed window, 16px gutters, 44px touch targets, disclaimer hidden, assistant content not indented
responsive.@xl (576px): framed window, 32px gutters, 36px buttons, content indented 38px under the byline
responsive.@3xl (768px): keyboard hint shows in the composer toolbar

accessibility: message list is role=log; each message is an article labelled 'You said' / '<name> said'
aria-busy on a message while it streams
visually hidden label on the textarea; aria-label on attach, send, stop, copy and new-thread buttons
Enter sends, Shift+Enter inserts a newline, IME composition is respected
send disabled when empty or while streaming
2px ink focus-visible rings, offset 2px, keyboard only

content.thread: A developer asks how to stop a search box firing on every keystroke; Wren answers with a debounce hook, a three-item list and three fictional sources, then streams a short follow-up about pressing Enter early
content.cannedReply: an honest placeholder that quotes the user's message and shows the shape a real answer would take

avoid: grey text that isn't white at an opacity
accent-coloured carets, bullets or focus rings
a static thread that just appears
